spikes.label: No way to reach a human

8.text: I sent $1,276 to my family in XXXX and the app promised delivery within minutes but it has been 21 days. I have screenshots of everything. Support keeps telling me to wait another 48 hours and opens a new ticket every time. They asked for more information about the recipient after I had already sent the money. If they cannot deliver it they should return the money instead of holding it.

My international transfer of $72 has been stuck in processing for 38 days. The status just says pending and the recipient bank says they have not received anything. Support keeps telling me to wait another 48 hours and opens a new ticket every time. My family needed this money for medical bills. I want it delivered or refunded including the fee.

I sent $247 to my family in XXXX and the app promised delivery within minutes but it has been 36 days. I have screenshots of everything. Support keeps telling me to wait another 48 hours and opens a new ticket every time. The status just says pending and the recipient bank says they have not received anything. I want a refund of the transfer fee at a minimum.

7.text: My instant transfer did not go through but the fee was still taken. They returned the money to my balance but kept the fee. Support said the fee is non refundable even though the service was not delivered. If the instant transfer is not instant I should not be charged for it.

I paid the instant transfer fee to move $246 to my bank but the transfer failed. This has happened multiple times and the fee is kept every time. Support said the fee is non refundable even though the service was not delivered. I want the fees refunded.

I paid the instant transfer fee to move $81 to my bank but the transfer failed. This has happened multiple times and the fee is kept every time. Support said the fee is non refundable even though the service was not delivered. I want the fees refunded.

6.text: The exchange rate I was charged on my transfer of $156 was much worse than the rate shown before I confirmed. The fee is buried in the exchange rate markup and is not disclosed clearly. The confirmation screen showed one amount and the receipt showed another. Fees should be shown clearly before you send money, not after.

The exchange rate I was charged on my transfer of $809 was much worse than the rate shown before I confirmed. The fee is buried in the exchange rate markup and is not disclosed clearly. This is deceptive and I want the difference refunded.

The app said no fees but the recipient received far less than $245. The confirmation screen showed one amount and the receipt showed another. The fee is buried in the exchange rate markup and is not disclosed clearly. This is deceptive and I want the difference refunded.

3.text: My account is restricted until I verify my identity but the verification system will not accept my ID. The photos are clear and my information matches but it still says we could not verify you. There is no option to talk to a person or send documents another way. I want a person to manually review my documents.

I have uploaded my driver's license and a selfie 4 times and the identity verification keeps failing. The photos are clear and my information matches but it still says we could not verify you. There is no option to talk to a person or send documents another way. I am stuck in a loop and cannot use my account.

I have uploaded my driver's license and a selfie 6 times and the identity verification keeps failing. The photos are clear and my information matches but it still says we could not verify you. There is no option to talk to a person or send documents another way. I want a person to manually review my documents.

9.text: I logged in and saw my balance of $439 was on hold and I could not withdraw anything. I have sent every document they asked for including my ID, bank statements and invoices but the hold is still there. They say it is a risk decision and they are not able to tell me why my money is frozen. I want my funds released immediately.

Without any notice the company froze my account and is holding $4,889 for 180 days. I have sent every document they asked for including my ID, bank statements and invoices but the hold is still there. They say it is a risk decision and they are not able to tell me why my money is frozen. This is my money and I need it to pay rent and bills. Holding it for six months is unacceptable.

5.text: A person posing as my utility company told me to pay $2,542 through the app or my power would be shut off today. I contacted them on XX/XX/XXXX and again on XX/XX/XXXX. When I filed a claim they told me peer to peer payments are not covered by purchase protection and closed the case. They denied my refund claim in less than a day without asking me a single question about what happened. There was no warning in the app before I sent the money even though the recipient account was brand new.

A person posing as my utility company told me to pay $164 through the app or my power would be shut off today. When I filed a claim they told me peer to peer payments are not covered by purchase protection and closed the case. The scammer's account is still active on the platform. I want my money back and I want them to warn customers.

10.text: I received an email saying my account is closed and I can no longer use the service. They will not tell me which policy I violated. My remaining balance of $79 has not been returned. Closing accounts without any reason is unfair.

My account was permanently closed today without any warning or reason. My linked bank account is now blocked from opening a new account too. They will not tell me which policy I violated. Closing accounts without any reason is unfair.

After years as a customer my account was shut down with no explanation. My linked bank account is now blocked from opening a new account too. They will not tell me which policy I violated. Closing accounts without any reason is unfair.

11.text: Someone logged into my account from another device, changed my email and phone number, and sent $45 to an account I do not know. I was locked out of my own account and the hacker drained my balance and linked bank account. Customer service said the transactions came from a recognized device so they consider them authorized. I never authorized these transactions and I want them reversed and my account secured.

I received a code by text I did not request and minutes later my account was used to make transfers totaling $83. Two factor authentication did not stop it because they changed the phone number on file first. Customer service said the transactions came from a recognized device so they consider them authorized. I still cannot access my account and nobody has called me back.

My account was hacked and the password and security settings were changed before I could do anything. I was locked out of my own account and the hacker drained my balance and linked bank account. Two factor authentication did not stop it because they changed the phone number on file first. The company should have flagged a new device changing every security setting at once.

12.text: I accidentally sent $805 to a stranger with the same name as my friend. The company says they cannot reverse it and I have to ask the recipient myself. The recipient will not respond and the company refuses to contact them. There should be a way to recover a payment sent by mistake.

The app autofilled the wrong contact and my payment of $162 went to someone I do not know. The company says they cannot reverse it and I have to ask the recipient myself. The recipient will not respond and the company refuses to contact them. I want help getting my money back.

I accidentally sent $83 to a stranger with the same name as my friend. I have screenshots of everything. There was no confirmation showing the recipient's full name before I sent it. The recipient will not respond and the company refuses to contact them. There should be a way to recover a payment sent by mistake.
